about: Published floor for NIDO Esencial: measured from the locally built knowledge-packs-v10 candidate (tanda C-04, 2026-11-01) and published as release knowledge-packs-v10 on 2026-11-02 (release 431496241; the files as served measure exactly these counts). Label corrected 2026-11-02 by the post-0.1.69 fix chain: this record still called itself a candidate after v10 shipped. A future Esencial candidate below these counts would silently take guides away from everyone who updates.

previousPublished.note: Size read from the signed catalog (src/models/manifest.ts) of the published v6 files; the trilingual candidate is +8192 bytes per file, not the ~+0.6 MB estimated in preparation.
